eventDetail.scope: 2027 International Conference on Consumer, Computing, and Communications Technology Systems (I3CTS)  is a multidisciplinary forum dedicated to the convergence of advanced computing foundations, consumer-centric applications, and modern pedagogical frameworks. The conference focuses on the synergy between Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain, and Quantum Computing to drive innovation across three strategic pillars:  Computing Foundations: Advanced algorithms, Quantum Machine Learning (QML), quantum-resistant cryptography, and scalable AI architectures (e.g., Transformer-based models and sensor fusion).  Consumer Technology: The integration of "Deep Tech" into Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS), secure IoT ecosystems, and the enhancement of user-centric electronics.  Educational Informatics: The digital transformation of learning through AI-driven adaptive platforms, Blockchain-verified credentialing, and emerging technology curricula for the global STEM workforce.
